**Finding submitted: deviation (high severity).**

§ 12.4 (p0046) imposes on us — the Customer — a non-compete running for the term plus **24 months**, covering "any product or service that competes with Vendor" in **any territory**, with no carve-out for internal development or acquisitions. That is squarely walk-away territory under NONCOMPETE: a post-term non-compete longer than 12 months *and* undefined scope. It fails the fallback on every material term.

It also directly contradicts § 12.3 (p0044), in which Vendor acknowledges that we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment — so deletion is the clean fix rather than a negotiated narrowing.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** delete p0046 in full, with a comment offering the narrowed fallback (single named product, term only, 12-month cap, internal-development and acquisition carve-outs) if the vendor pushes back.

Note: the no-hire/no-solicit restriction at p0045 is a separate restrictive covenant and I left it for its own rule rather than double-flagging it here.
